title: Pairwise Poisson Algebras of the N-Body Problem
description: Symbolic and numerical computation of the Lie algebra generated by pairwise interaction Hamiltonians of the N-body problem under the Poisson bracket. Establishes the dimension sequence [3, 6, 17, 116, 5914] for N=3 (OEIS A395423; last term a certified mod-p lower bound) and its universality across potentials, spatial dimensions (through level 3), mass ratios, and charge magnitudes; extends to N=4 ([6, 14, 62, 1260]), N=5 ([10, 25, 145, 5965]) and higher N at level 2. Cross-CAS verified in SymPy, Wolfram Language and SageMath. Includes a mod-p jet-evaluation engine. Includes the algebra engine, multi-system survey scripts, AWS atlas-scan infrastructure, structure-constant analyses, and the LaTeX sources of the accompanying paper series.
